content.short: Clear Contracts turns Cardano Plutus smart contracts into simple no-code forms for communities and DAOs.
content.description: Clear Contracts is a Cardano tooling project that lowers the barrier for people and communities to use smart contracts. It wraps Plutus logic inside simple web forms so users can create, manage, and execute contract workflows without writing code. The project also supports DAO-style use cases, including governance rules and on-chain votes, through interfaces built for non-technical operators. Clear Contracts is useful for Cardano communities that need practical smart contract access without building custom front ends.
content.meta: Clear Contracts makes Cardano smart contracts easier to use through no-code forms and DAO tooling. Explore Clear Contracts on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
